exact_text: Fernando selected a presenter-operated demonstration with screen-sharing and **one demo JWT user/principal**, without multi-user management. Screen-sharing means the presenter operates the interface; it does not give the client their own browser endpoint. Existing authentication and backend service identity controls remain distinct; an acquirer/merchant/terminal reference is business context, not the identity of the demo user. No permanent token or secret belongs in the HTML. Exact token/session and deployment realization remains subject to the existing architecture/security gates.
disposition: Separate reviewed documentation follow-up to overlay K-3/P-1; no guide mutation, no14th delta, not evidence every product document is harmonized
